# International Cinematographers Guild Local 600

> > The International Cinematographers Guild (ICG) Local 600 represents camera professionals and cinematographers across North America, providing member resources, industry recognition, and community support.

ICG Local 600 is the IATSE union representing cinematographers, camera operators, and related crafts. The guild offers member services, industry news, awards programs including the Publicists Awards, and coordinates charitable initiatives supporting both members and the broader community.

## Key Topics

- International Cinematographers Guild
- ICG Local 600
- IATSE
- American Society of Cinematographers (ASC)
- Cinematographers and camera professionals
- Union member resources
- Publicists Awards
- Disaster relief and emergency assistance
- Community service and philanthropy

- Camera equipment industry partners
- Film and television production
- Young Workers initiatives
- Labor federation partnerships
